items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: The interviewer mentions Brickle Alexander and asks 'Did you know him?' to Alvin Prenial, not the interviewee. The interviewee only responds 'Oh, I see.' to the interviewer's monologue.

ctx.x: He's lived down on the end.

Yeah. There's so many of those people like that you can't think of. Anyway... He died, didn't he? I don't know. Brickle Alexander? I don't know. I really don't know. I've forgotten. I... It's funny. You forget who's alive. I think he is. Alvin Prenial. Alvin Prenial. Did you know him? Yeah. I saw him a few weeks ago. That's my cousin.
